metadataRaw.title: Fix Clicking Shoulder in Seconds #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of shoulder popping, clicking, and cracking sounds.

This exercise may help quickly loosen tight muscle tendons and ligaments, which is a big cause of those annoying sounds.

This exercise can be done at home and may give quick shoulder pain tightness relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS.

Let us know how it works for you!
